headline: Ukrainian Drones Strike Russian Pipeline Hub, Refineries, and Power Plants
summary: Ukrainian drones struck critical energy and industrial infrastructure across Russia, setting fires at an oil pipeline station in Bashkortostan and a refinery in Samara.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Direct military strikes on major petroleum processing and transport hubs disrupt export supply chains.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Overnight drone attacks targeting key regional oil refining and pipeline assets raised immediate concerns over refining capacity losses in Russia.
